payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate i from 1 to k, construct even-length palindrome by concatenating i and its reverse, accumulate sum modulo p.
payload.rationale: The solution does not search; it directly generates the k smallest zcy numbers using a deterministic construction. No backtracking, bitmask, branch and bound, DFS/BFS, or permutation enumeration. Thus it doesn't fit complete_search family.
